messages:
jess: heads-up — planning a measured rollout for model-zenith-v2 into catalog at 10:30 UTC tonight. goal: 10% traffic -> 30% -> 60% over 45m with warmup tokens + KV cache priming. looking for ops + releases ack.

mike: ack on timing. what's the pin strategy for older models during the lift? some enterprise customers still on v1.9.

jess: good q. we'll pin v1.9 for customer segments: enterprise-sla, gov-namespace. public routes get gradual traffic shift. config: `pinlist: ["enterprise-sla", "gov-namespace"]`, fallback order: [zenith-v2-quant, zenith-v2, zenith-v1.9].

natalie: QA: we validated semantic parity on our eval set (50 prompts). small regressions around code formatting — we'll add a safety prompt map to force `language: markdown` when code blocks detected.

ryan: rollout guardrails I'd like to add:
- rollback if 99p generation latency increases by >30% vs baseline for 10m
- rollback if error-rate (5xx or truncated responses) >0.8% for 5m
- memory OOMs on any gpu node -> immediate drain and rollback

carla: release notes draft for marketing + docs: 
"Model Zenith v2: improved factuality and 2x inference throughput for shorter contexts. Note: slight formatting changes in code blocks; enable `code-format: true` in prompts to preserve previous behavior."

deploybot: running preflight checks...
```
deploybot: preflight: model artifacts verified (sha256: 9a7c...f2)
deploybot: infra check: GPU pool capacity OK (available: 14/16)
deploybot: canary route test: PASS (latency 95p=98ms, errors=0.12%)
deploybot: obs hooks: instrumentation toggled for zenith-v2
```

mike: can we pin a canary route specific to eu-west for the first 10%? want to validate regional telemetry.

jess: yes — canary routing: `region_shard: eu-west` for 10% slot. after 15m, expand to global 30%.

natalie: adding eval hooks: will run nightly regression suite and post summary to #eng-ml. also enabling token-delta diff on a sampled 1k requests.

ryan: on rollback mechanics: who owns manual rollback? ops-stage will trigger automated rollback if thresholds hit; manual rollback should be an ENG-RELEASES + SRE vote (2 approvers). SRE oncall will own the immediate drain action.

sre-oncall: I can take immediate on-call action. pls ensure the runbook link is in the deploy message.

jess: noted. runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/model-rollouts#zenith-v2 (included in deploybot commit message).

carla: small request — include a short upgrade note for SDK users in the release: `response.formatting` toggled default. I'll paste the snippet before 10:00 UTC.

deploybot: staging to prod cutover schedule created: 
- 10:30 UTC start (eu-west canary 10%)
- 10:45 expand to global 30%
- 11:00 expand to 60%
- 11:15 monitor, then decide full 100% or hold
deploybot: pinlist and fallback order applied to config: `catalog/zenith-v2/rollout/1717779999.yaml`

mike: any expected perf regression for long context > 4k tokens?

natalie: perf profile shows tail latency increases ~10% on >6k sequences in lab but no memory spikes. we won't route >6k into the canary. we'll add a header-based guard: `x-max-seq=4096` on canary route.

ryan: also enable KV cache prefilling for customers on the canary to avoid init spikes. add `cache.prefill=true` in canary policy.

jess: final checklist before 10:30:
- [x] preflight checks (deploybot)
- [x] QA eval + prompt mitigations (natalie)
- [x] release notes + SDK note (carla)
- [x] pinlist + fallback ordering (jess)
- [x] runbook link & SRE ack (sre-oncall)
- [x] regional canary routing configured (mike)

jess: if no objections by 10:20 UTC I'll kick the deploy. :thumbsup:

mike: +1

carla: +1

ryan: +1 — ops prepared for auto-rollback

natalie: +1 from QA

deploybot: deploying zenith-v2 canary -> eu-west (10%)...
```
deploybot: step 1: apply config -> OK
deploybot: step 2: route update -> OK
deploybot: step 3: smoke tests -> OK
```

jess: post-deploy note: observe 95p latency 102ms (baseline 98ms), errors 0.14% (baseline 0.12%). within guardrails. will update channel at each expansion.

mike: seeing EU logs look clean. adding a short traffic split tag to customers in enterprise-sla so they remain pinned.

deploybot: expansion to global 30% in 15m scheduled. will tweet progress here. :robot_face:

sre-oncall: reminder — if auto-rollback triggers, runbook requires: 1) set catalog pin back to zenith-v1.9 2) drain nodes with zenith-v2 3) notify customers in pinned segments 4) open an incident if >30m to recover.

jess: thanks all. I'll close this thread after final 60% ramp or rollback decision.
